original.text: Hey, come hang out. I'm just fixing this gate before we jump back in. Did you change that setting? Yeah, that's the one. Give me a second... okay. There we go.

everyday.text: Hey, come hang out. I'm just fixing this gate before we jump back in. Did you change that setting? Yeah, that's the one. Give me a second... okay. There we go.

playful.text: Hey, come hang out. Wait... did you fix it? Oh, it worked! That was actually awesome. Okay, I'm impressed. You nailed it. There we go.

soft.text: Hey. That was rough. I really thought we'd get them home. Give me a second... okay. We'll figure it out together. I'm still here.

questions.text: Did you change that setting? What did you change? The blue one? Oh, the green one. Yeah, that's the one I meant. Are we ready now?

limits: Approved recordings provide source reference performances, not a guaranteed emotional-control API.
Frustrated/concerned/surprised and every newly rendered row remain intended until listening QA.
No pitch shifting, time stretching or synthetic emotion effects.
Reference identity remains the original A2; all variants were synthesized from it and accepted by the owner.
